The growth figures (S2, S9) align with the stated transition from restructuring to organic growth (S1). Regional performances (S10-S13) provide context without conflicting with each other or with financial metrics. The equity and debt improvements (S15) reinforce the financial resilience claim (S14). Strategic initiatives (S17-S18) logically extend from the reported performance. No unnecessary repetition or organizational issues are present; each sentence adds distinct information that builds a coherent whole.
